meta_title: Business Tour Five Realms — 5-Player Mod & Install Guide
meta_description: Explore Five Realms for Business Tour: a 5-player mod with a 40-cell pentagonal board, five resorts, mixed map themes, Windows installation guide and release downloads.
hero_kicker: Business Tour, with room for one more
hero_title: Five players. A whole new angle.
hero_description: Take the tour around a 40-cell pentagon. Five regions, five resorts, and a fifth seat at the table—with the familiar Business Tour rules at its heart.
hero_note: Windows x64 · Everyone uses the same package · Start in a private, no-bet room
board_preview_note: Illustrated layout—not a gameplay screenshot. Regional artwork varies by seed.
features_title: The tour gets a fifth side.
features_description: A real expanded route, not just a new shape. The special map brings its own five-player layout while leaving the original four-player maps scoped to their native rules and HUD.
feature_board_body: Five sides of eight cells, with an extra resort and three added cities in their own property group. Original properties retain their prices and groups.
feature_regions_body: Seeded combinations of Classic, Fantasy and Wonderland visuals. Compatible beach, island, stadium and ship artwork keeps special cells recognizable.
feature_rules_body: Three actual Chance cells and two each of Lost Island, Tax and traps. Paired special cells sit half a lap apart; original card effects and economic formulas stay intact.
feature_hud_body: Five compact player cards, five Pause cards, a real fifth-player Ready check, and a distinct coral-orange player color. Right-hand controls stack vertically.
feature_art_body: Roomier tiles, separate name and rent bands, fitted Chance artwork and reanchored flags. Purchase windows keep their native geometry; money text has bounded enlargement.
feature_connection_body: Background keep-alive settings and a local missed-roll AFK guard. These do not guarantee protection from server kicks, maintenance or network loss.
quick_note: Use the full ZIP, including Setup, Uninstall and the English guide.
quick_step_3: Close the game and run Setup
quick_step_4: Select Five Realms in a private room
critical_title: The same package, on every PC
critical_body: Five Realms is not host-only. Every participant needs the same exact mod package and supported game build. Do not mix vanilla clients or older previews with this release.
scope_description: Keep the test setup simple: matching mod packages, matching game builds, and a private room with no wagers.

host_point_2: Confirm the supported Steam game build
host_point_3: Create a private, no-bet room; start with four bots

guest_point_1: Match the host's game and mod versions
guest_point_2: Do not mix releases, previews or vanilla clients

install_title: From ZIP to your first roll.
install_description: The package includes the compatible BepInEx loader. Setup checks the game files and creates a safety backup before making changes.
install_step_1_body: Download BusinessTourFiveRealms-0.2.2-win-x64.zip, or the matching package for your chosen release. GitHub's Source code archives are not the playable mod bundle.
install_step_1_tip: Choose the versioned Five Realms Windows ZIP
install_step_2_body: Use Extract All, then open the extracted folder. Keep Setup, Uninstall, README, release notes and checksums together.
install_step_2_tip: Keep the full package for updates and removal
install_step_3_body: Close Business Tour. Run BusinessTourFiveRealms-Setup.exe, confirm the folder containing BusinessTour.exe, then choose Install. Check files is available before changing game files.
install_step_3_tip: No terminal commands or separate loader download needed
install_step_4_body: Start through Steam. Create a private, no-bet room, choose Five Realms — 5 Players, and add four bots for the first test.
install_step_4_tip: Original maps should still use their four-player layout
verify_description: In the special map, look for your player card plus four bot cards, a pentagonal 40-cell board, and five resorts. A five-slot lobby alone is not a complete gameplay test.

verify_limit_title: A release, not a stability guarantee
verify_limit_body: Development tests reached one human plus four bots. Full matches, five human clients, every payment state, long AFK sessions, reconnects and host migration remain unverified. Final 0.2.1 visual fixes have not been retested in-game.

help_description: A few answers for installing, joining and getting back to the original game.
faq_smartscreen_q: Why does Windows show an unknown publisher?
faq_smartscreen_a: The community installer is not code-signed. Check its origin and compare the published SHA-256 checksum before running it. An unknown-publisher warning is not a safety guarantee; do not disable Windows security.
faq_game_path_q: Which game folder should I choose?
faq_game_path_a: Choose the folder containing BusinessTour.exe, not BusinessTour_Data or BepInEx. In Steam, open Business Tour → Properties → Installed Files → Browse to find it.
faq_access_q: Setup says files are in use or another installer is open.
faq_access_a: Close Business Tour and any Five Realms Setup or Uninstall window. Wait for an active operation to finish, then try again. If access is still denied, check folder permissions and the error details; do not delete game files at random.
faq_four_slots_q: Why do I still see four players?
faq_four_slots_a: Four-player maps intentionally stay unchanged. Restart after installation and select Five Realms — 5 Players. A square board or 32-cell route is not a successful 40-cell expansion; check the mod log if that happens.
faq_guests_q: Do my friends need Five Realms too?
faq_guests_a: Yes. Everyone needs the same exact package and compatible game version. This is not a host-only mod, and five-human networking has not been fully verified.
faq_remove_q: How do I remove the mod?
faq_remove_a: Close the game and run BusinessTourFiveRealms-Uninstall.exe. It removes Five Realms files and settings, while keeping the shared BepInEx loader, unrelated mods and Steam game files. Safety backups are retained for recovery.
